from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, statistics, subprocess, sys
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=Path('/tmp/clonk-rs-next-simulation-perf')
cases={
 'tower':['Collection.c4f/Puzzles.c4f/4_TowerOfMagic.c4s','600','0'],
 'arso':['EkeReloaded.c4f/TheStippelAge.c4f/Arso-Morf.c4s','600','424242'],
 'stippel1000':['EkeReloaded.c4f/TheStippelAge.c4f/Arso-Morf.c4s','600','424242','1000'],
 'clonkmars':['ClonkMars.c4f/03_Chaos.c4s','600','424242'],
 'sevenkeys':['Missions.c4f/SevenKeys.c4s','600','0'],
 'tutorial':['Tutorial.c4f/Tutorial01.c4s','600','424242'],
}
mode=sys.argv[1]
assert mode in ('timings','states')
runs=[]
for repeat in range(3 if mode=='timings' else 1):
 for case,args in cases.items():
  for label in (['baseline','candidate'] if repeat%2==0 else ['candidate','baseline']):
   directory=out/mode/f'{case}-{label}-{repeat}'
   directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
   env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('LC_APP_','LC_RUST_ENGINE_','LC_PROFILE_'))}
   env.pop('LC_CONTENT_ROOT', None)
   env.update(LC_PROFILE_MODE='tick', LC_PROFILE_WARMUP='100')
   if mode=='states':env['LC_PROFILE_STATES']=str(directory/'checkpoints')
   print('START',directory.name,flush=True)
   binary=out/'bin'/f'scenario-{label}'
   with (directory/'run.log').open('w') as log:
    result=subprocess.run([str(binary),*args],cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   if result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError(f'{directory.name}: process exited {result.returncode}; see {directory}/run.log')
   report=next(json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]) for line in (directory/'run.log').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('LC_REFERENCE_PROFILE '))
   report.update(case=case,variant=label,repeat=repeat,mean_ms=statistics.mean(report['frame_ns'])/1e6,executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
   (directory/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
   runs.append(report)
   (out/f'{mode}-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
   print('DONE',directory.name,round(report['mean_ms'],4),'ms',flush=True)
tools.build_harness.py:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = Path(os.environ.get('LC_PROFILE_REPO', '/tmp/clonk-rs-script-bookkeeping'))
target = Path('/Users/tyler.ashworth/Downloads/clonk-rs-performance-followups/target/release')
label = sys.argv[1]
kind = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'scenario'
examples = list((target/'.fingerprint').glob('clonk-engine-*/example-scenario_profile.json'))
example = max(examples, key=lambda item: item.stat().st_mtime_ns)
fingerprint = json.loads(example.read_text())
externs = []
provenance = {}
for _, name, _, dep_hash in fingerprint['deps']:
    if name not in ('clonk_engine', 'clonk_resources', 'clonk_script', 'serde_json'): continue
    matches = []
    for item in (target/'.fingerprint').glob(f"*/lib-{name}"):
        if int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(item.read_text().strip()), 'little') == dep_hash:
            matches.append(item)
    assert len(matches) == 1, (name, dep_hash, matches)
    lib = target/'deps'/f"lib{name}-{matches[0].parent.name.rsplit('-',1)[1]}.rlib"
    externs.extend(['--extern', f'{name}={lib}'])
    provenance[name] = {'path': str(lib), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(lib.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'fingerprint': dep_hash, 'cargo_metadata': json.loads(matches[0].with_suffix('.json').read_text())}
command = ['rustc', '--edition=2021', '--crate-name', f'reference_{kind}_profile', '-C', 'opt-level=3', '-C', 'lto=thin', '-C', 'codegen-units=1', '-C', 'linker=.cargo/macos-system-clang', '-L', f'dependency={target}/deps', *externs, str(out/f'harness/{kind}.rs'), '-o', str(out/f'bin/{kind}-{label}')]
env = dict(os.environ, CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR=str(repo/'crates/clonk-engine'))
subprocess.run(command, env=env, cwd=repo, check=True)
(out/f'harness/{kind}-{label}-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':command,'libraries':provenance},indent=2))
print(f'Built {label}', flush=True)
